claims.text: The FDA label says temazepam and alcohol produce additive central nervous system depression.
claims.quote: The benzodiazepines, including temazepam, produce additive CNS-depressant effects when co-administered with other CNS depressants such as alcohol

claims.text: The FDA label says alcohol appears to increase the risk of sleep-driving behaviors with temazepam.
claims.quote: Although behaviors such as “sleep-driving” may occur with temazepam capsules alone at therapeutic doses, the use of alcohol and other CNS depressants with temazepam capsules appears to increase the risk of such behaviors, as does the use of temazepam capsules at doses exceeding the maximum recommended dose.

headline.text: The FDA label describes additive central nervous system depression with temazepam and alcohol.

reported.text: The label reports additive depressant effects with alcohol.
It also describes an apparent increase in sleep-driving risk with alcohol during temazepam treatment.
